resources.string: Applies a configured SMSC only when a supported SmsManager send path and confident SIM/carrier routing signal are available.
Target app packages (comma-separated). Invalid entries are rejected; Android framework scope is always required.
Enable temporary detailed diagnostics (may include technical routing metadata)

The module replaces an SMSC only for verified send APIs and confident SIM/carrier signals. Unknown or conflicting signals preserve the original SMSC. Save settings, scope the module to android and your SMS app, then reboot or restart scoped apps.
Saved. Reboot device or restart scoped apps to reload configuration.
Settings were saved, but the Xposed-readable preferences file could not be confirmed. Reboot and run the self-check before sending messages.
Invalid SMSC format. Use 5–20 digits with an optional leading +.
Invalid package list. Use comma-separated Android package names with no invalid entries.
Self-check passed: stored SMSC values and target package scope are valid.
Self-check failed. Re-save settings and verify SMSC and package formats.
